newsitem.title: USA: Javelin signs $24 mln distributor pact.
newsitem.headline: Javelin signs $24 mln distributor pact.

text.p: TUSTIN, Calif., April 29 (REuter) - Javelin Systems Inc, a developer of touch-screen point-of-sale terminals, on Tuesday said it signed a distribution deal with Britain-based Riva Electronics Ltd valued at about US$24 million.

Riva was granted exclusive distribution rights in Western Europe, Scandinavia, Eastern Europe and the Russian Republics for for Javelin's point-of-sale computers which are designed primarily for foodservice and hospitality industries.
Riva agreed to purchase roughly US$24 million of products over a three-year period. The deal can be renewed with promises to purchase not less than $7.8 million per six-month period.
This new, exclusive distribution pact augments a current agreement between Javelin and Riva, announced Dec. 9, 1996.

Under that deal, Riva agreed to purchase a minimum of about US$2.3 million in Javelin computers over 12 months. Currently, Riva's purchases exceed $500,000 and are "well ahead of schedule," Javelin said in a statement.
